temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits he has been hiding something and that he is in some kind of trouble, which he did not know how to tell Christian about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is hiding something important from him and feels anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Christian's suspicion is confirmed; Jonathan was hiding something, and Christian learns Jonathan is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan has been hiding a serious trouble and has now admitted it.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxious, suspicious, then worried and concerned
temporal_state_chain.intention: To uncover the truth about Jonathan's trouble and decide how to respond.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated, does not want to drag Christian into it, but admits he could use support and resources and needs a way out of the mess.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is in trouble and has been hiding it from him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Christian learns Jonathan's trouble is complicated and that Jonathan is reluctant to involve him but is open to receiving support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan needs Christian's help, support, and resources to get out of his complicated trouble.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer help, support, and resources so Jonathan can get out of the mess.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he might have gotten involved with the wrong people but denies doing anything illegal himself; Christian decides to investigate discreetly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan needs support and resources for a complicated trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Christian now suspects Jonathan's trouble may be related to criminal activity or wrong people, though Jonathan claims he did nothing illegal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan's trouble may involve criminal or dangerous people, but Jonathan asserts his own innocence.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate discreetly without alarming Jonathan and to make sure Jonathan is safe.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed; Christian tells Jonathan and says he has leads and will gather more evidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan's trouble may involve wrong people or criminal activity, but the full truth is unclear.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Christian now believes Jonathan is being framed and is innocent.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is being framed by someone, and evidence must be gathered to prove his innocence.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear Jonathan's name by gathering evidence and proving his innocence.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian has found out that the real culprit is someone close to both him and Jonathan; he tells Jonathan he will confront this person.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is being framed, but the identity of the culprit is unknown.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Christian now believes the real culprit is someone both he and Jonathan know and trust.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Someone close and trusted by both Christian and Jonathan is responsible for framing Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice.
